statement: Pinned SDL reads six address bytes at offsets 4 through 9 of the full USB 0x81 status reply for command 0x01 and reverses them into its stored address. On the Bluetooth device-info subcommand 0x02 path it copies the six address bytes into the same storage in reply order.

applicability.scope: SDL_hidapi_switch.c: the status packet fields at lines 232–240 and BReadDeviceInfo at lines 629–654 establish SDL's interpretation. No physical hardware or firmware capture was tested.
